previous_sampling.rule: Complete nonoverlapping 50-endpoint blocks inside uninterrupted background runs; no joining across row discontinuities, known records, or action intervals.
previous_sampling.budget: Common total number of background blocks across all group sizes/compositions within each partition. Largest budget is the minimum eligible block count rounded down to a multiple of 4*lcm(1,...,K).
previous_sampling.draws: With replacement within each selected participant; equal block counts per person; paired nested draws across budgets; shared draws across all fitted pipelines.
previous_sampling.anchors: Four timing anchors contribute equally to global thresholds. Age anchors use all query ages of the selected calibration people and remain fixed across that group's record resamples.
previous_sampling.excluded: Incomplete background blocks are excluded only from block resampling; full-data references retain all original background endpoints.

reason: Calibration metadata showed complete-block filtering excluded short background intervals. Replaced it with circular within-run moving blocks so every background endpoint has equal expected sampling weight; evaluation arrays had not been opened in the new analysis.

code_repairs.reason: Independent reconstruction detected float32 accumulation in mean-age anchors (original REALDISP maximum discrepancy 9.641e-6 s). Recompute all group anchors using float64; protocol, block draws and score thresholds unchanged.
